files.AGENTS.md:
# Study workspace

This scaffold belongs to the study. Allagma updates preserve it. Read
`ALLAGMA.md` (or the generated path recorded in `.allagma/ownership.json`) for
the selected recipe. Recover a campaign before choosing its method bundle.
Keep scientific code and evidence in the study. Do not edit generated bundles.

Preserve the user's GUI model selection; do not add project-level model or
review_model pins without an explicit request.
files.CLAUDE.md:
# Study workspace

Use the study-local Allagma entrypoint recorded in `.allagma/ownership.json`.
Select the campaign and read its pinned bundle before executing a method.
This file is study-owned and is not replaced by bundle updates.
files.README.md:
# r04

The study owns this scaffold, its domain code, overrides, evidence and paper.
Allagma owns `.allagma/bundles/` and the paths in `.allagma/ownership.json`.
Edit `allagma.yaml` to express selection intent, then explicitly plan and adopt
an update. Existing campaigns retain their own locks and configuration.
files.modules-local/README.md:
# Local method variants

Study-owned variants belong here, outside immutable bundles. Each variant
declares its base module and replacement scope. Export a candidate source
containing the variant, select it explicitly, and follow the normal update
protocol. Never patch a generated bundle in place.
files.overrides/README.md:
# Study overrides

Put settings in `settings.json` using JSON-compatible YAML. Selection intent
lists these files. Each resolution records values, leaf-level origins and
input digests. Edited overrides require a new lock before starting a new
campaign. Resuming an existing campaign uses its frozen configuration.
